notes: Each photograph is used once. The first screen takes a wide picture no section has named; if every wide one is named, it takes the first and that row stands without a picture.
A small picture is never a backdrop and never wider than its pixels; portraits go only to the people they belong to.
No alt is shown as text. Control names (menu, close, previous, next) are aria-labels; the one visible function word is 'from' before a price marked from:true.
No logo file is read: the name is set in type across the first screen and in the header, as the reference's wordmark is.
needs (as written): one wide photograph for the first screen
needs (as written): steps.items with their own pictures or team with portraits
drops (as written): catalogue item and group pictures (the same pictures stand in the rows)
drops (as written): project photographs beyond the first free one
drops (as written): team.groups[].t (the people are shown, the group names are not)
drops (as written): photographs beyond the slots (person1 2 of 9, local1 7 of 20)
motif (as written): the client's own photographs (media.made is never read)
